Welcome to Velocity Suites.

By creating an account, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agreed to comply with the following Terms and Agreement.

1. You agree that all personal information provided during registration is accurate, complete, and truthful. Providing false or misleading information may result in the suspension or termination of your account.

2. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials, including your email address, mobile number, and password. Do not share your login information with other individuals.

3. Velocity Suites collects your personal information solely for account management, room reservations, payment processing, customer support, security, and other hotel-related services. Your information will be handled in accordance with applicable privacy laws and will not be disclosed to unauthorized third parties without your consent unless required by law.

4. You agree to use the Velocity Suites application only for lawful purposes. Any fraudulent booking, unauthorized access, abusive behavior, or misuse of the system may result in account suspension or permanent termination.

5. Room availability, reservation confirmation, promotional offers, prices, and hotel services are subject to change without prior notice.

6. Reservation cancellations, refunds, modifications, and payment processing are subject to the hotel's cancellation and payment policies.

7. Velocity Suites reserves the right to reject, suspend, or terminate accounts that violate these Terms and Agreement or any applicable laws and regulations.

8. Users are responsible for ensuring that all booking details and personal information remain accurate and up to date.

9. Velocity Suites implements reasonable security measures to protect user information; however, users are also responsible for protecting their own account credentials.

10. By selecting the agreement checkbox and continuing with the registration process, you confirm that you voluntarily agree to these Terms and Agreement and consent to the collection and processing of your personal information for hotel management purposes.

Velocity Suites Hotel Terms, Conditions, and Policy

By proceeding with this transaction, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to the following Velocity Suites hotel policies.

1. Check-In Window
The Check-In date of every Booking and Reservation must be today or within the next two (2) days. Dates outside this window are not accepted.

2. Room Availability Policy
Room types shown during creation reflect availability at the time of your request. Availability is re-verified before your transaction is confirmed, and again immediately before submission is completed, to prevent overbooking.

3. Duplicate/Overlapping Date Prevention
A guest may not hold more than one active Booking or Reservation with overlapping stay dates, regardless of room type. Overlapping requests will be rejected.

4. Check-In and Check-Out Policy
Standard Check-In and Check-Out times apply as posted at the property. Early Check-In or late Check-Out is subject to availability and may incur additional charges.

5. Guest Information and Capacity Policy
The representative guest named on the transaction is responsible for the accuracy of all guest information provided. The declared number of guests must not exceed the selected room's stated capacity.

6. Guest Responsibility Policy
The representative guest is responsible for the conduct of all guests under the transaction and for any damage caused during the stay.

7. Reservation Policy
A Reservation provisionally holds your requested dates and room type pending confirmation and, where applicable, payment verification.

8. Booking Policy
A Booking is confirmed once payment has been submitted and, for GCash payments, verified by hotel staff.

9. Reservation Modification Policy
Reservation details may be modified once prior to conversion or Check-In, subject to room availability for the newly requested dates. A confirmed Booking's room or primary guest can no longer be changed.

10. Reservation-to-Booking Conversion Policy
A Reservation may be converted into a Booking by Velocity Suites once payment requirements are satisfied. Conversion preserves the original stay dates and guest details and does not create a duplicate transaction.

11. Cancellation Policy
A Booking or Reservation with no payment, or with only a partial payment, may be cancelled subject to the hotel's cancellation rules. A fully paid Booking cannot be cancelled by the guest.

12. Non-Refundable Policy
Any amount already paid toward a Booking is non-refundable upon cancellation, except where required by law or expressly approved by hotel management.

13. No-Show Policy
If a guest fails to arrive within the hotel's allowed Check-In window on the scheduled Check-In date, the transaction may be marked as a No-Show and moved to Cancelled status. Amounts already paid remain non-refundable.

14. Payment Verification Policy
GCash payments are reviewed by hotel staff before a transaction is marked Confirmed. Cash payments are settled and verified directly at the property.

15. Partial and Full Payment Policy
Where offered, guests may pay a partial percentage of the total amount or the full amount at the time of transaction. Any remaining balance is due according to the hotel's payment schedule.

16. Hotel's Right to Reject or Cancel
Velocity Suites reserves the right to reject, cancel, or reschedule a Booking or Reservation in cases of suspected fraud, data errors, room unavailability beyond the hotel's control, or violation of these policies.

17. Other Applicable Policies
Additional house rules and applicable local regulations apply throughout the stay and are available at the property.

GCash Payment Policy (this transaction)\nThis transaction is set to be paid via GCash. Your payment is held as Pending until verified by hotel staff, which is typically completed within the hotel\'s standard processing time. A rejected or unverifiable GCash payment will not confirm the transaction, and any amount already paid remains subject to the Non-Refundable Policy above.

Cash Payment Policy (this transaction)\nThis transaction is set to be paid in Cash. Cash payments are settled and verified directly at the property, at or before Check-In. The Cancellation, No-Show, and Non-Refundable Policies above apply equally once any payment has been made.
